name: flexrican_toola_data_graph
title: FlexRICAN Toola Data Graph and Input Dataset Metadata
description: This OEMetadata record describes the data architecture, input datasets, processing steps, assumptions and output indicators used by FlexRICAN Toola. It is structured as a lightweight ontology-oriented metadata record: Toola data entities are represented as nodes and their methodological relationships are represented as subject-predicate-object relationships. The record documents the provenance of input datasets, including Ember EnergyMIX data and a curated country-level carbon intensity summary table, and explains how these data are used in Toola calculations such as grid electricity emissions, renewable energy contribution, scenario comparison and battery-storage assessment. The purpose is to support reproducibility, traceability, validation and later review of Toola input data and model assumptions.

resources.name: toola_data_relationships
resources.title: FlexRICAN Toola Data Relationships
resources.description: Ontology-oriented relationship table describing the main entities and dependencies within the FlexRICAN Toola data architecture. Each row represents one relationship in the form subject-predicate-object. The relationship graph links source platforms, raw datasets, curated Toola input tables, assumptions, calculation steps and output indicators. The primary Ember EnergyMIX workbook is treated as the wider reference dataset. The curated carbon intensity table is treated as a Toola input dataset derived from Ember data and used to calculate country-level grid electricity emissions. The relationship graph is intended as a reproducibility and validation layer, not as a replacement for the actual source data files.

sources.title: Ember Electricity Data Explorer
sources.description: Primary data source for the EnergyMIX workbook and country-level electricity carbon intensity values. The relevant data blocks include electricity generation, capacity, demand, imports, power-sector emissions and CO2 intensity by country and year. The source data are used to create two Toola-relevant artefacts: a long-format EnergyMIX reference dataset and a curated country-level carbon intensity summary table.

sources.title: 01_EnergyMIX_of_EU_Countries_EMBER.xlsx
sources.description: Primary Ember-derived long-format working dataset for Toola. The workbook contains the sheet yearly_full_release_long_format with country-year observations structured by Area, ISO 3 code, Year, Area type, Continent, Ember region, EU, OECD, G20, G7, ASEAN, Category, Subcategory, Variable, Unit, Value, YoY absolute change and YoY percent change. It provides contextual information on electricity generation mix, capacity, demand, imports and power-sector emissions.

sources.title: 02_Carbon_intensities_of_EU_Countries_EMBER.xlsx
sources.description: Curated Toola input table containing country-level electricity carbon intensity values for 2024 and 2025. The table is derived from Ember data and simplified for use in Toola calculations. It contains one record per country or economy and separate year-specific carbon-intensity columns.
